messages:
alex: Heads-up — EU canary for v2 just showed a small spike in 500s (~0.9% -> 3.7%) right after the header normalization change. Not huge but sustained for ~2 min. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary deployment v2 -> eu-west-1 detected error budget spike. Auto-pause triggered at 5% error threshold. Canary traffic frozen. (runbook: /playbooks/canary-pause) :warning:

maria: I saw the logs, looks like downstream clients sending `X-Client-Schema: 1` without the hyphen sometimes, our normalization turned that into `x-client-schema` and the routing rule missed it. Header case + dash normalization edge-case.

alex: ah that explains it — client check in mobile SDK was lower-cased header matcher for older clients. We didn't add the dash-insensitive rule. Did we mention this in release notes?

tom: Not in the notes. This is one of those compatibility gotchas. Mobile SDK 2.3.1 still sends the old header format. If we resume canary, it will hit those clients. Suggest pin EU routes to v1 while we patch.

sarah: Agree with pin. Suggested quick mitigation: patch the router to accept both `x-client-schema` and `xclientschema` (short term) OR revert header normalization. Which is less risky?

maria: Short-term tolerant matcher is safe and small. I can push a tiny config flag to routing rules within 15–20m. But we need to update release notes and call out SDK compatibility matrix.

ken: Ops question — if we pin EU to v1, can we still roll forward globally? We need to avoid split-brain for telemetry.

alex: Yes, pin is regional only. Plan: 1) Keep canary paused (deploy-bot did that) 2) Apply tolerant matcher in eu-west 3) Pin eu routes to v1 for any incoming client with `sdk_version < 2.4` 4) Patch notes + send @customers-notice if necessary 5) Resume a tiny canary after verification.

tom: Command for pinning (ops):
```
# pin route eu-* to v1 for older SDKs
/routing pin --region eu-west-1 --matcher "sdk_version<2.4" --target v1 --reason "v2 header-normalization regressions"
```

maria: Pushing the tolerant matcher now -> patch in routing-config repo -> deploy to eu-west staging then prod. ETA ~18m. I'll post commit and diff.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing config deployment started: routing-config@patch-3129 -> eu-west-1. Track: https://deploys/repo/routing-config/3129 :building_construction:

ken: I'll open a short-lived incident ticket and add rollback criteria (error rate >2% sustained for 5m OR client 500s on auth path). Ticket #INC-2026. Adding release-notes owner.

alex: Maria — once patch is live, let's run the smoke suite for EU (auth flows + SDK handshake). If green, we'll lift the pin for new clients only and then do a broader rollout.

maria: Patch is live in eu-west staging, rolling to prod in 3m. Commit: https://git/repo/routing-config/commit/abc123 — added tolerant matcher + tests.

deploy-bot: deploybot: routing-config@abc123 -> eu-west-1 prod deploy succeeded.

sarah: Running smoke tests now... auth OK, handshake OK, sample mobile clients (2.2, 2.3) handled. No 500s in last 2m.

tom: Proceed to pin command now and attach rollback hook.

alex: Done the pin. Command issued and confirmed in routing control plane. PIN ID: pin-8892. Will keep telemetry in high fidelity for 30m.

ken: Incident created: INC-2026. Release notes doc updated: https://confluence/release/v2-notes (added section about header normalization and SDK compatibility). Will notify accounts if we see any customer-facing errors.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary remains paused. Regional pin pin-8892 active. Monitoring window: 30m. Auto-unpin disabled for pin-8892.

maria: Filing a tiny hotfix PR to add dash-insensitive matching for the v2 router so we don't need the pin long-term. PR: https://git/repo/routing/PR-4321

alex: Good. Let's keep this thread as the coordination point. If tests stay green for 30m we'll consider resuming a 1% canary to validate broader clients, otherwise rollback to global v1 and schedule a proper patch rollout.

tom: Note for release notes: add snippet for customers on how to detect affected clients (look for header variants, SDK <2.4). I'll add an FAQ blurb.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Monitoring update at +10m: error rate back to baseline (0.8%). Pin still active.

sarah: +1 all clear so far. Will keep an eye during the 30m window.

alex: Thanks team — action items: maria -> hotfix PR, ken -> incident doc, tom -> notes FAQ, I'll follow-up with PM for customer comms.

deploy-bot: deploybot: At +35m monitoring window expired. Pin pin-8892 remains (auto-unpin disabled). For manual unpin run: `/routing unpin pin-8892`.
